changes: First issue: static riser geometry, tension and available-length screening are presented so that the calculation boundary is explicit.
The documented riser example and a published cable geometry are distinguished from measured validation and installation acceptance.
Missing strength, fatigue and environmental inputs are recorded as requirements for further assessment.
An independent coated-example worksheet was added to check component weights, submerged weight, static forces and the available-length boundary against fixed illustrative inputs.
The report was registered for isolated regeneration so changes to its inputs and inventory are detected.
